plugins.name: dev-day
plugins.description: Developer day-loop: session bootstrap with feedback memory + plan-gate, Jira standup/triage/groom/create, clean Jira comments, and end-of-day learning capture.

plugins.name: tdd-pipeline
plugins.description: Gated TDD build pipeline, ticket to Done: /build plans with click-approval; /implement runs test-writer → implementer → test-runner → multi-specialist review (security, quality, money-logic, concurrency) → changelog; /ship verifies the build receipt, then branches, commits, pushes and opens the PR, moving the ticket to In Review; /merged verifies the merge, parks the ticket for validation and cleans up branches; /validated records your sign-off and closes it; /build-epic dry-runs an epic's tickets as buildable or blocked. Jira optional; nothing hardcoded.

plugins.name: side-panel
plugins.description: Mod: right-side dashboard pane for the open project (model, branch and session timer; prompt-cache countdown; needs-you, Jira, todos; agents as a TDD stage rail and spawn tree; current topic, left-undone items)

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Mod: numbered answer buttons for the Questions block that ends a reply

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Mod: catch secrets in a prompt before it is sent: mask, send anyway or cancel
